name: Kishk
description: Bulgur fermented with yogurt for weeks, dried and ground to a sour powder that keeps a year.

tcm.note: A dried grain and dairy ferment.

unani.note: Outside the classical record; garam-khushk by the ferment.

histamine.note: Weeks of yogurt fermentation, then drying — grain and dairy ferment at once.

nutrition.highlight: it keeps for a year, and does
